312b3('dul ba): gzhungs shing mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par bris pa la zhus dag lan gsum du bgyis te bzhengs pa rnams/sa mo glang gi lo bkra shis lo gsar gyi zla ba la legs par grub cing /'bras bu dang bsgrub pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya phrag drug dang /lung mngon pa'i dus kyi 
312b4('dul ba): bzhi brgya brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis 'das la/lhag ma mngon pa'i lo bcom rgyang dang /mdo sde/'dul ba/rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i lnga brgya phrag gsum ste/stong lnga brgya bcwa brgyad bstan pa'i lhag mar yod pa'i dus su bka' 'gyur legs par grub pa 
312b5('dul ba): rnams las 'di dag ni lung sde bzhi'o//'dul ba lung phal che ba la dge slong pha ma'i so sor thar pa dang /zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bzhengs pa med mod kyi 'on kyang so sor thar pa gnyis rnam 'byed gnyis kyi rtsa ba yin zhing /rnam 'byed gnyis ni so sor thar pa rnam 
312b6('dul ba): ba gnyis kyi 'grel pa yin la/zhu ba ma rdzogs pa ni zhu ba dag shos yin pa'i phyir lung rnam 'byed so so'i dbu dang /gzhung bla ma ma rdzogs pa dbu nyid du bzhengs so//lung sde bzhi'i go rims ni gzhi dang /rnam par 'byed pa dang /de dag gi dka' ba'i 
312b7('dul ba): gnas zhus lan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa gzhung bla ma dang /de dag tu ma tshang ba kha skong ba phran tshegs so//don gyi go rims de ltar yin yang mkhas pa rnams kyis gzhi dang /rnam par 'byid pa'i rjes la phran tshegs dang /de'i rjes la gzhung dam pa nyid 
313a1('dul ba): @#//bris shing /ka cog la sogs pas mdzad pa'i mtshan byad dkar chag las kyang rim pa de lon ltar 'byung bas 'dir yang gzhung dam pa mjug nyid du bris so//'di rnams kyi bam po'i grangs ni sho lo ka sum brgya la bam po rer byas nas 
313a2('dul ba): lung gzhi la bam po brgya dang dgu/dge slong pha'i rnam 'byed la bam po brgyad bcu rtsa gsum dang bam po sum cha/dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed la bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad/phran tshegs la bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu/gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa la bam po bcu 
313a3('dul ba): gnyis/zhu ba rdzogs pa'i gzhung dam pa la bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum ste/bsdoms na gzhung dam pa la bam po drug bcu rtsa lnga yod pas spyir lung sde bzhi tshang ba la bam po sum brgya bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi dang bam po sum cha yod do//sngar ma tshang ba rnams tshang
